summary: A cost-led offshore SI proposes a modernization plan emphasizing deep offshore leverage, rate-card pressure, and delivery governance risk. Normalize the bid by separating foundation, per-workload conversion, sourcing mix, residual manual work, and pillar evidence. title: small source to landing P50 P80 P95 effort band
name: small source to landing P50 P80 P95 effort band
summary: The inventory classifies source to landing as small because it has low object count and simple dependencies. Start from 2-6 person-weeks before automation, then adjust for 35-70% automation leverage, residual source authentication, PHI or sensitive-data handling, CDC semantics, and reconciliation, dual-run, cutover, and decommission. Present P50, P80, and P95 with confidence; never a single exact estimate.
